title: Tech Note: Components in 4D v11 SQL
author: Luis Pineiros, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This documents a genuine architectural turning point for 4D's component system, and the core concept of 4D Components as a distribution mechanism for reusable code is still very much alive today; however, the specific v11 SQL-era component format and creation process described has since been superseded by further evolutions of the component/plugin architecture in subsequent 4D versions.
related_updates: 4D's component architecture has continued to evolve significantly since v11 SQL, including compiled component changes and, later, the ability to build components in Project Mode (2018+)
Modern 4D component distribution also increasingly involves ORDA-aware components and the 4D package/dependency model
